record.label: Exact modular addition with clean ancillas
record.statement: The circuit preserves $y$ and adds $z(y)$ to any initial value $b$ of the output register modulo $2^{25}$. The ancillas start and finish in $\lvert0\rangle^{\otimes m}$.
record.boundary: Take output code $2^{25}-1$ in the first 25 positions of `rData` and input code $2^{23}$ for $+1$ in the next 25. The table gives $z(y)=13{,}176{,}795$, so modular addition gives output code $13{,}176{,}794$. The rule holds on all $2^{50}$ computational basis states and extends to their superpositions. The error bound applies to the inputs in $[-1,1]$.
